```{r Runs the same dharma check on any model}
dharma_check <- function(model, data, predictors = c(), label = "", nsim = 1000, seed = 123) {
  for (mode in c("unconditional", "conditional")) {
    cat("\n====", label, "-", mode, "simulations ====\n")
    sr <- simulateResiduals(model, n = nsim, simulateREs = mode, seed = seed)
    plot(sr, title = paste(label, "-", mode))
    print(testUniformity(sr, plot = FALSE))
    print(testDispersion(sr, plot = FALSE))
    print(testQuantiles(sr, plot = FALSE))
    for (v in predictors) {
      cat("\n-- residuals vs", v, "--\n")
      plotResiduals(sr, form = data[[v]], main = paste(label, mode, "vs", v))
    }
    sr_sess <- recalculateResiduals(sr, group = data$subj_session)
    cat("\n-- residuals aggregated by subject-session --\n")
    print(testDispersion(sr_sess, plot = FALSE))
  }
}
```

```{r}
long.data <- read.csv("long_data_final.csv", header = TRUE)

long.data$subject  <- as.factor(long.data$subject)
long.data$partner  <- as.factor(long.data$partner)
long.data$dyad     <- as.factor(long.data$dyad)
long.data$role     <- as.factor(long.data$role)
long.data$condition <- as.factor(long.data$condition)
long.data$trial_type <- as.factor(long.data$trial_type)
long.data$CSI <- as.numeric(long.data$CSI)
long.data$subject_sex <- as.factor(long.data$subject_sex)

# Scale trial number and session number for modeling
long.data$total_session_number_z <- scale(long.data$total_session_number_by_subject, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
long.data$trial_within_session_z <- scale(long.data$trial_within_session, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

# NEW (v6): Experience enters the models on a log scale. Blocker removal in the Early trials
# dropped steeply over the first sessions and then levelled off, which a straight line on the
# logit scale could not capture (DHARMa: residuals vs. session and vs. fitted values failed).
# log_total_z = standardized log(total session number for that subject).
# One SD of log session = 0.781, i.e., a 2.18-fold change in session number.
long.data$log_total_z <- as.numeric(scale(log(long.data$total_session_number_by_subject)))

# NEW (v5): Session-level random intercept. Trials within the same session for the same subject
# were more similar to each other than the model expected (DHARMa dispersion test on residuals
# aggregated by subject-session failed). One level per subject per session (80 levels).
long.data$subj_session <- interaction(long.data$subject, long.data$total_session_number_by_subject,
                                      drop = TRUE, sep = "_S")

long.data$condition <- relevel(long.data$condition, ref = "Unilateral")
levels(long.data$condition)
levels(long.data$trial_type)
levels(long.data$dyad)
```

```{r Identify Early Trials for Reciprocity Model}
# Keep only rows where the focal subject received food early:
#   role a in early_a and early_early trials
#   role b in early_b and early_early trials
early.data <- long.data %>%
  filter(!is.na(focal_trial_type), focal_trial_type != "end_end")
```

```{r Compute Reciprocity Variable: Partner's Prior Helping Rate}

# Binarize blocker removal (any removal = 1, no removal = 0)
recip.data$a_blocker_binary <- ifelse(recip.data$subject_a_blocker > 0, 1, 0)
recip.data$b_blocker_binary <- ifelse(recip.data$subject_b_blocker > 0, 1, 0)

# Partner's prior helping rate: proportion of earlier Early/End trials (within dyad x condition)
# in which the individual was rewarded early and moved its blocker for the partner
recip.data <- recip.data %>%
  arrange(dyad, condition, total_session_number, trial_within_session) %>%
  group_by(dyad, condition) %>%
  mutate(
    a_opp = as.numeric(trial_type == "early_a"),   # A rewarded early, B needs help
    b_opp = as.numeric(trial_type == "early_b"),   # B rewarded early, A needs help
    a_prior_help_rate = lag(cumsum(a_blocker_binary * a_opp)) / lag(cumsum(a_opp)),
    b_prior_help_rate = lag(cumsum(b_blocker_binary * b_opp)) / lag(cumsum(b_opp))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(across(c(a_prior_help_rate, b_prior_help_rate), ~ ifelse(is.nan(.x), NA, .x))) %>%
  select(-a_opp, -b_opp)

# For Alternating sessions only, see if the preceding trial was helpful to the subject
recip.data <- recip.data %>%
  arrange(dyad, condition, total_session_number, trial_within_session) %>%
  group_by(dyad, condition, total_session_number) %>%
  mutate(
    # Store subject B's blocker value only on early_b trials
    last_early_b_b_blocker = ifelse(
      condition == "Alternating" & trial_type == "early_b",
      subject_b_blocker,
      NA
    ),

    # Store subject A's blocker value only on early_a trials
    last_early_a_a_blocker = ifelse(
      condition == "Alternating" & trial_type == "early_a",
      subject_a_blocker,
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
  fill(last_early_b_b_blocker, last_early_a_a_blocker, .direction = "down") %>%
  mutate(
    Alternating_recip_binary = case_when(
      condition == "Alternating" & trial_type == "early_a" ~ last_early_b_b_blocker,
      condition == "Alternating" & trial_type == "early_b" ~ last_early_a_a_blocker,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-last_early_b_b_blocker, -last_early_a_a_blocker)

# Merge prior helping rates back into long data for the early-blocker trials
early.data <- early.data %>%
  left_join(
    recip.data %>%
      select(observation, trial_within_session, a_prior_help_rate, b_prior_help_rate, Alternating_recip_binary),
    by = c("observation", "trial_within_session")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    partner_prior_help = ifelse(role == "a", b_prior_help_rate, a_prior_help_rate)
  )

early.data$partner_prior_help_z <- scale(early.data$partner_prior_help, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
```

# MODEL 1 - Blocker Removal Across Trial Types --------------------------------

```{r Model 1 Build - Blocker Removal Across Trial Types}
# Set reference level to end_end (baseline - no early option available)
long.data$trial_type <- relevel(long.data$trial_type, ref = "end_end")

# Use focal_trial_type, which recodes trial type from the focal subject's perspective:
#   solo_early = only I received food early (early_a for role a; early_b for role b)
#   both_early = both subjects received food early (early_early)
#   end_end    = neither subject received food early
# NA rows are role a in early_b trials and role b in early_a trials — excluded.
# Reference = solo_early so the key contrast is both_early vs. solo_early directly.

# Model 1 data only cares about end/end, early/early, and the focal subject in the early/end trial (not the other one)
model1.data <- long.data %>%
  filter(!is.na(focal_trial_type))

# Null model (v5: same random-effect structure as the full model)
NULL_M1 <- glmer(blocker_binary ~ 1 + (1 | subject) + (1 | partner) + (1 | subj_session),
                 family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                 data = model1.data,
                 control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 200000)))

# v4 model, kept ONLY for comparison with the v5 model (failed DHARMa checks; do not report)
M1_OLD <- glmer(blocker_binary ~ focal_trial_type*condition + total_session_number_z*focal_trial_type + trial_within_session_z + partner_apparatus + focal_trial_type*CSI + focal_trial_type*partner_apparatus +
              condition*CSI +
              (1 | subject) + (1 | partner),
            family = binomial(link = "logit"),
            data = model1.data,
            control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 200000)))

# Model 1: focal_trial_type and condition
# Key contrast: both_early vs. solo_early — did subjects help as much when
# their partner was also already rewarded versus when only they were?
# apparatus included to control for the number of times the partner interacted with the apparatus
# v5 CHANGES: (1) log_total_z replaces total_session_number_z (non-linear learning curve)
#             (2) (1 | subj_session) added (trials clustered within sessions)

M1 <- glmer(blocker_binary ~ focal_trial_type*condition + log_total_z*focal_trial_type + trial_within_session_z + partner_apparatus + focal_trial_type*CSI + focal_trial_type*partner_apparatus +
              condition*CSI +
              (1 | subject) + (1 | partner) + (1 | subj_session),
            family = binomial(link = "logit"),
            data = model1.data,
            control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 200000),
                                   calc.derivs = TRUE))

V_M1 <- as.matrix(vcov(M1, use.hessian = TRUE))


anova(NULL_M1, M1, test = "Chisq")

# M1 with linear learning rate vs new M1 with log scale learning rate (lower AIC = better)
AIC(M1_OLD, M1)
```

```{r Model 1 Summary and Interactions}
summary(M1)

Anova(M1, type = 3)

#tab_model(M1,
#          show.est = TRUE, show.ci = 0.95,
#          show.p = TRUE, p.style = "numeric",
#          show.se = TRUE, show.r2 = TRUE,
#          show.zeroinf = FALSE,
#          show.re.var = FALSE, show.icc = FALSE,
#          title = "GLMM Predicting Blocker Removal Across Trial Types")

# Marginal means for all focal_trial_type x condition cells
EMM_M1 <- emmeans(M1, ~ focal_trial_type * condition, type = "response")
EMM_M1
# Critical comparison: both_early vs. solo_early within each condition
pairs(EMM_M1, by = "condition", adjust = "holm", type = "response")
confint(pairs(EMM_M1, by = "condition", adjust = "holm", type = "response"))

EMM_M1_trial <- emmeans(M1, ~ focal_trial_type, type = "response")
# Critical comparison: leaving out the interaction with condition
pairs(EMM_M1_trial, adjust = "holm", type = "response")

# Can also look at between Unilateral and Alternating Conditions
pairs(EMM_M1, by = "focal_trial_type", adjust = "holm", type = "response")
summary(pairs(EMM_M1, by = "focal_trial_type", adjust = "holm", type = "response"),
        infer = TRUE)
```

```{r Model 1 Session Number x Trial Type Interaction}
# Session Number and Trial Type Interaction
# v5: slope is now per 1 SD of log(session). The OR per doubling of session number
# (e.g., session 2 -> 4, 4 -> 8) is easier to report, so it is computed below as well.
EMM_sessionxTT <- emtrends(M1, specs = ~ focal_trial_type, var = "log_total_z")
#CIs
sess_tr <- summary(EMM_sessionxTT, infer = TRUE)
sess_tr
sd_log_sess <- sd(log(long.data$total_session_number_by_subject))
k_double <- log(2) / sd_log_sess
data.frame(focal_trial_type = sess_tr$focal_trial_type,
           OR_per_doubling  = exp(sess_tr$log_total_z.trend * k_double),
           LCL = exp(sess_tr$asymp.LCL * k_double),
           UCL = exp(sess_tr$asymp.UCL * k_double),
           p   = sess_tr$p.value)

```

```{r Check Model 1 Assumptions}
vif(M1_simple)
rm(M1_simple)
```

```{r}
# Graph each subject's helping rate as a function of relationship quality.

    method = "lm",

    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)

    x = "Dyadic CSI",

  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

# MODEL 2 - Latency to move blockers ------------------------------------------
```{r Model 2 - Latency to move blocker by trial type and condition}
library(splines)

latency.data$focal_trial_type <- as.factor(latency.data$focal_trial_type)
latency.data$focal_trial_type <- relevel(latency.data$focal_trial_type, ref = "solo_early")
latency.data$condition        <- relevel(latency.data$condition, ref = "Unilateral")
latency.data$subj_session     <- droplevels(latency.data$subj_session)

# Null model
NULL_LAT <- glmmTMB(blocker_latency ~ 1 + (1 | subject) + (1 | partner) + (1 | subj_session),
                    family = gaussian, data = latency.data)
# Latency model: focal_trial_type x condition
# Prediction: both_early coefficient should be positive (longer latency = less motivated)
LAT_M <- glmmTMB(blocker_latency ~ focal_trial_type * condition +
                   ns(total_session_number_by_subject, df = 3) + trial_within_session_z +
                   (1 | subject) + (1 | partner) + (1 | subj_session),
                 family = gaussian, data = latency.data)

anova(NULL_LAT, LAT_M)
```

```{r Model 2 Summary and Interactions}
Anova(LAT_M, type = 3)

# Estimates are now in seconds
summary(pairs(emmeans(LAT_M, ~ focal_trial_type)), infer = TRUE)   # Early/End vs Early/Early
summary(pairs(emmeans(LAT_M, ~ condition)), infer = TRUE)          # Unilateral vs Alternating
summary(pairs(emmeans(LAT_M, ~ focal_trial_type * condition), by = "condition"), infer = TRUE)

# Predicted latency across sessions (describes the spline)
emmeans(LAT_M, ~ total_session_number_by_subject,
        at = list(total_session_number_by_subject = c(1, 4, 8, 16)))

summary(LAT_M)$coefficients$cond["trial_within_session_z", ]
```


```{r Check Model 2 Assumptions}
# LATENCY MODEL FAILS dharma CHECKS!!!!---------------------------

             predictors = c("total_session_number_by_subject", "trial_within_session_z",
                            "focal_trial_type", "condition"),
             label = "Latency")
```

# MODEL 3 - Reciprocity: Partner's Prior Helping Predicts Current Helping -----

```{r Test for reciprocity in the Alternating sessions, as predicted}
# First see if previous helping in the Alternating sessions had any effect on helping in the current early/end trial
Alternating_recip_subset <- early.data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Alternating_recip_binary))

Alternating_recip_summary <- Alternating_recip_subset %>%
  group_by(Alternating_recip_binary) %>%
  summarise(
    n_trials = n(),
    n_moved = sum(blocker_binary, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_moved = mean(blocker_binary, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

Alternating_recip_summary

# Run a GLMM with binary distribution to see if there really was an effect
Alternating_recip_subset$Alternating_recip_binary <- as.factor(Alternating_recip_subset$Alternating_recip_binary)

# Trial number in the session and total session number added as covariate to account for experience
Alternating_recip_model_glmer <- glmer(
  blocker_binary ~ Alternating_recip_binary + log_total_z + trial_within_session_z +
    (1 | subject) + (1 | partner) + (1 | subj_session),
  data = Alternating_recip_subset,
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", calc.derivs = TRUE)
)

NULL_M3 <- glmer(blocker_binary ~ 1 + (1 | subject) + (1 | partner) + (1 | subj_session),
                 data = Alternating_recip_subset, family = binomial,
                 control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
anova(NULL_M3, Alternating_recip_model_glmer)

summary(Alternating_recip_model_glmer)
# Odds Ratios
exp(fixef(Alternating_recip_model_glmer))
# Wald's Type III Chi Sq
Anova(Alternating_recip_model_glmer, type = 3)
# Table output
tab_model(Alternating_recip_model_glmer,
          show.est = TRUE, show.ci = 0.95,
          show.p = TRUE, p.style = "numeric",
          show.se = TRUE, show.r2 = TRUE,
          show.zeroinf = FALSE,
          show.re.var = FALSE, show.icc = FALSE,
          title = "GLMM Predicting Helping from Partner's Prior Helping in Alternating Sessions")

exp(cbind(OR = fixef(Alternating_recip_model_glmer),
          confint(Alternating_recip_model_glmer, method = "Wald", parm = "beta_")))

```

```{r Check Model 3 Assumptions}
# v5: This model already passed DHARMa, so it is unchanged. Its session covariate covers only
# the 4 Alternating sessions, and a session random intercept did not improve fit (AIC 171.4 vs 170.3).
dharma_check(Alternating_recip_model_glmer, Alternating_recip_subset,
             predictors = c("log_total_z", "trial_within_session_z", "Alternating_recip_binary"),
             label = "Alternating reciprocity")

```

```{r Model 3 Robustness - Quantile Test Calibration and Session as Factor}
# Model 3 failed the DHARMa quantile test in some runs. Two follow-up checks:

# (1) Calibration: how often does the quantile test flag a problem when the model is correct?
# Simulate 100 data sets from the fitted Model 3, refit the model to each, and run the same test.
set.seed(1)
M3_sims <- simulate(Alternating_recip_model_glmer, nsim = 100)
M3_cal_p <- sapply(1:100, function(k) {
  d <- Alternating_recip_subset
  d$blocker_binary <- M3_sims[[k]]
  mk <- suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(update(Alternating_recip_model_glmer, data = d)))
  sr <- simulateResiduals(mk, n = 250, simulateREs = "conditional", seed = k)
  testQuantiles(sr, plot = FALSE)$p.value
})
mean(M3_cal_p < .05)   # proportion of correct-model data sets flagged at p < .05 (nominal = .05)

# (2) Robustness: session within the Alternating condition as a factor instead of log(session)
M3_sessfactor <- glmer(
  blocker_binary ~ Alternating_recip_binary + factor(session_in_condition) + trial_within_session_z +
    (1 | subject) + (1 | partner) + (1 | subj_session),
  data = Alternating_recip_subset,
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 200000))
)
Anova(M3_sessfactor, type = 3)
exp(cbind(OR = fixef(M3_sessfactor), confint(M3_sessfactor, method = "Wald", parm = "beta_")))
dharma_check(M3_sessfactor, Alternating_recip_subset,
             predictors = c("trial_within_session_z", "Alternating_recip_binary"),
             label = "Model 3 - session as factor")
```

```{r Post Hoc Model 3 - Examining the Direction of Attitudinal Reciprocity}
AR_baseline_subset <- early.data %>%
  filter(focal_trial_type == "solo_early") %>%  # critical: Early/End only
  mutate(
    AR_baseline_group = case_when(
      condition == "Unilateral" ~ "Unilateral baseline",
      condition == "Alternating" & as.character(Alternating_recip_binary) == "1" ~ "Alternating: previously helped",
      condition == "Alternating" & as.character(Alternating_recip_binary) == "0" ~ "Alternating: not previously helped",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    AR_baseline_group = factor(
      AR_baseline_group,
      levels = c(
        "Unilateral baseline",
        "Alternating: previously helped",
        "Alternating: not previously helped"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(AR_baseline_group))

AR_baseline_subset %>%
  group_by(AR_baseline_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_trials = n(),
    n_moved = sum(blocker_binary, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_moved = mean(blocker_binary, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# v5 CHANGES: log_total_z replaces total_session_number_z, and (1 | subj_session) added.
# Partner intercept retained for consistency across models; its variance is estimated at zero
# (singular fit), so the fixed-effect estimates are identical with or without it.
AR_baseline_model_glmer <- glmer(blocker_binary ~ AR_baseline_group + log_total_z + trial_within_session_z + 
                                   (1 | subject) + (1 | partner) + (1 | subj_session),
  data = AR_baseline_subset,
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

NULL_M4b <- glmer(blocker_binary ~ 1 + (1 | subject) + (1 | partner) + (1 | subj_session),
                  data = AR_baseline_subset, family = binomial,
                  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
anova(NULL_M4b, AR_baseline_model_glmer)
```


```{r Model 3 Summary and Contrasts}

exp(fixef(AR_baseline_model_glmer))

AR_emm <- emmeans(AR_baseline_model_glmer, ~ AR_baseline_group)

AR_custom_contrasts <- contrast(
  AR_emm,
  method = list(
    helped_vs_unilateral = c(-1, 1, 0),
    not_helped_vs_unilateral = c(-1, 0, 1),
    helped_vs_not_helped = c(0, 1, -1)
  ),
  adjust = "Holm"
)

summary(

  type = "response"
)
```

# MODEL 4 - CUMULATIVE PAST HELPING

```{r Model 4 - Blocker Movement based on Partner's Previous Cumulative Helping}
# Restrict to trials where focal subject has an early blocker and prior helping data is available
recip.model.data <- early.data %>%
  filter(focal_trial_type == "solo_early",
         condition == "Unilateral",
         !is.na(partner_prior_help_z))

recip.model.data$condition <- relevel(recip.model.data$condition, ref = "Unilateral")

# Null model
NULL_M4 <- glmer(blocker_binary ~ 1 + (1 | subject) + (1 | partner) + (1 | subj_session),
                 family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                 data = recip.model.data)

# Model 2: Partner's prior helping rate predicts focal subject's blocker removal
# v5 CHANGES: log_total_z replaces total_session_number_z, and (1 | subj_session) added.
M4 <- glmer(blocker_binary ~ partner_prior_help_z + log_total_z + trial_within_session_z +
              (1 | subject) + (1 | partner) + (1 | subj_session),
            family = binomial(link = "logit"),
            data = recip.model.data,
            control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 200000)))

anova(NULL_M4, M4, test = "Chisq")
```

```{r Model 4 Summary and Interactions}
summary(M4)

Anova(M4, type = 3)

tab_model(M4,
          show.est = TRUE, show.ci = 0.95,
          show.p = TRUE, p.style = "numeric",
          show.se = TRUE, show.r2 = TRUE,
          show.zeroinf = FALSE,
          show.re.var = FALSE, show.icc = FALSE,
          title = "GLMM Predicting Helping from Partner's Prior Helping Rate")

# Probe the Partner Prior Help x Condition interaction (if significant)
# Interaction not signficant
# FIX (v5): M4 is fit to Unilateral trials only and has no condition term,
# so emtrends(~ condition) and pairs() errored. Now reports the single slope.
reciprocity_slopes <- emtrends(M4, ~ 1, var = "partner_prior_help_z")
reciprocity_slopes
reciprocity_OR <- summary(reciprocity_slopes, infer = TRUE)
reciprocity_OR$OR <- exp(reciprocity_OR$partner_prior_help_z.trend)
reciprocity_OR

# Interpretation of Coefficients:
# As predicted by our last model, condition had a significant effect, with them less likely to move it in the Alternating condition
# They also had a significant decrease in helping with trial number
```

# MODEL 5 SI - SOLICITATION -------------------------

```{r Model 5 Build - Solicitation Behaviors}
# Apparatus contacts (count outcome - Poisson or Negative Binomial)
# Using subject-level long format; apparatus = number of apparatus contacts


# Check for overdispersion in apparatus contacts
mean(long.data$partner_apparatus, na.rm = TRUE)
var(long.data$partner_apparatus, na.rm = TRUE)

# Null models
NULL_M5a <- glmer(partner_apparatus ~ 1 + (1 | subject) + (1 | partner),
                  family = poisson(link = "log"),
                  data = long.data)

NULL_M5b <- glmmTMB(partner_apparatus ~ 1 + (1 | subject) + (1 | partner),
                    family = nbinom2(link = "log"),
                    data = long.data)

# Compare Poisson vs. Negative Binomial for apparatus contacts
AIC(NULL_M5a, NULL_M5b)

# Model 3b: Apparatus contacts by trial type and condition
M5a <- glmmTMB(partner_apparatus ~ trial_from_partner_perspective * condition +
                 (1 | subject) + (1 | partner),
               family = nbinom2(link = "log"),
               data = long.data)

summary(M5a)
Anova(M5a, type = 3)

# Look within trial type
MM_M4_Solicit <- emmeans(M5a, ~ trial_from_partner_perspective, type = "response")
# Critical comparison: leaving out the interaction with condition
pairs(MM_M4_Solicit, adjust = "holm", type = "response")
confint(pairs(MM_M4_Solicit, adjust = "holm", type = "response"))

# The partner solicited significantly more when it needed help than when it did not.
# They also solicited significantly more when they needed help than when they both had to move the blockers for end end trials

```

```{r Figure 4 - Effect of Previous Trial Helping}
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3) +

  # Previously helped vs previously not helped: *
  geom_segment(aes(x = 2, xend = 3, y = 1.16, yend = 1.16),
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 2, xend = 2, y = 1.14, yend = 1.16),
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 3, xend = 3, y = 1.14, yend = 1.16),
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 2.5, y = 1.19, label = "*"),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5) +

  # Unilateral baseline vs previously not helped: ***
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1, xend = 3, y = 1.24, yend = 1.24),
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1, xend = 1, y = 1.22, yend = 1.24),
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 3, xend = 3, y = 1.22, yend = 1.24),
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 2, y = 1.27, label = "**"),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5) +

  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", family = "Times", size = 11),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "none")

ggsave("Figure_4 [FINAL].png", height = 4.5, width = 3.5, units = "in", dpi = 600)
```

```{r Figure 5 [Not Used] - Individual-Level Helping Rates Across Sessions}
library(dplyr)

by_session_individual <- long.data %>%
  group_by(subject, dyad, condition, session_in_condition) %>%
  summarise(
    help_rate = mean(blocker_binary, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

by_session_learning <- model1.data %>%
  group_by(focal_trial_type, condition, session_in_condition) %>%
  summarise(
    help_rate = mean(blocker_binary, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(by_session_learning, aes(x = session_in_condition, y = help_rate,
                                  group = focal_trial_type, color = focal_trial_type)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7, position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)) +
  geom_line(size = 1, position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)) +

  facet_wrap(~ condition) +

  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

  )
```

```{r}
apparatus_summary_raw <- model1.data %>%
  group_by(
    subject,
    partner,
    focal_trial_type,
    partner_apparatus
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_removed = sum(blocker_binary, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_total = sum(!is.na(blocker_binary)),
    prop_removed = n_removed / n_total,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

apparatus_summary_raw$focal_trial_type <- factor(
  apparatus_summary_raw$focal_trial_type,
  levels = c("end_end", "solo_early", "both_early"),
  labels = c(
    "End / End",
    "Early / End",
    "Early / Early"
  )
)

ggplot(
  apparatus_summary_raw,
  aes(
    x = partner_apparatus,
    y = prop_removed
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(size = n_total),
    alpha = 0.55,
    color = "black",
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0.015
    )
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "glm",
    method.args = list(
      family = binomial(link = "logit")
    ),
    aes(weight = n_total),
    se = TRUE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ focal_trial_type,
    nrow = 1
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = "Number of Trials",
    range = c(1.5, 5)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Partner Apparatus Interactions",
    y = "Proportion of Trials in which Blocker was Removed"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      family = "Times",
      size = 13
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      family = "Times"
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      family = "Times",
      size = 13
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16)
  )
```
